meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成代码改动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Generate explainer videos from code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把一个 GitHub PR（代码改动）转成讲解视频：读取 PR 的 diff、提交和文件，按代码编辑风格逐帧生成 changelog、特性展示、修复或重构讲解，最终输出视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N，或在已检出仓库里说“这个 PR”，并要求做成讲解视频时触发；不是产品宣传或无 PR 主题时不会走此技能。

say.text: 把这个 PR 生成一段改动讲解视频。
say.note: 会读取该 PR 并产出逐帧讲解视频。

say.text: 把 acme-sdk#1842 做成一个 changelog 视频。
say.note: 按 changelog 原型规划分镜和脚本。

say.text: 当前仓库这个 PR，做成修复讲解。

howto.what_en: On install, Claude turns a GitHub PR (a code change) into an explainer video: it reads the PR's diff, commits, and files, and builds a frame-by-frame code-editorial video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough — ending with a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user gives a PR reference (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or “this PR” in a checked-out repo) and asks for an explainer video; not for product promos or non-PR topics.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a change-explainer video.
say_en.note: Reads the PR and produces a frame-by-frame video.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for acme-sdk#1842.
say_en.note: Plans storyboard and script as a changelog.

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer for this PR in the current repo.
say_en.note: Structures it as a fix walkthrough.
